description.text: Grants [Change Machinery Mode (Fire, Lightning, Poison)], [Damage Cap +10000], [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Edgar], [Royal Shock Damage Tracker] and [Royal Shock Level]

description.name: Change Machinery Mode (Fire, Lightning, Poison)
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire]/[Attach Lightning]/[Attach Poison] after using a Fire/Lightning/Poison ability

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Edgar
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Royal Shock (0~2), removed after using Royal Shock two times

description.name: Royal Shock Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Royal Shock level by 1 after dealing 100001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Edgar]

description.name: Royal Shock Level
description.text: Keeps track of Royal Shock level (0~1), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Edgar]
